'''2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Olaf Schroeder LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Olaf Schroeder]] at [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
